body:
Dimensions Mod

Dimensions Mod introduces a pocket dimension system built around resource extraction under pressure. You place a raw material into the Dimensional Generator, pay 500 RF to open a portal, and step into a freshly generated world built entirely from that block — giving you access to massive amounts of resources you would never find in a normal world.

The catch? You have roughly 90 seconds. Grab what you can, avoid the mobs spawning around you, and get out before the portal closes. Every run is a risk-reward decision.

## How it works
Place a **Dimensional Generator** on the ground and connect an **Energy Injector** within 2 blocks. Insert your chosen material into the generator, pay the 500 RF entry cost, and a portal opens in front of you. The world on the other side is generated entirely from the block you inserted — diamond becomes a diamond world, gold ore becomes a gold world and so on.

Once inside, you are on a timer. Hostile mobs spawn throughout the dimension and the portal will not stay open forever. Collect as much as you can carry and return before time runs out.

Optionally, place a **Stabilizer** anywhere within a 2 block cube around the generator before opening the portal. This reduces mob spawns and softens the environment inside, giving you a slightly easier run — at the cost of extra materials to craft it.

## Available Dimensions
| Material | Dimension |
|----------|-----------|
| Diamond | Diamond Block Dimension |
| Gold Ingot | Gold Block Dimension |
| Iron Ingot | Iron Block Dimension |
| Emerald | Emerald Block Dimension |
| Lapis Lazuli | Lapis Block Dimension |
| Copper Ingot | Copper Block Dimension |
| Coal | Coal Block Dimension |
| Quartz | Quartz Block Dimension |
| Amethyst Shard | Amethyst Block Dimension |
| Redstone | Redstone Block Dimension |
| Netherite Ingot | Netherite Block Dimension ⭐ |
